name: Falooda
description: Chilled Pakistani falooda layered with rose syrup, basil seeds, vermicelli, cold milk and vanilla ice cream for a creamy dessert drink.
ingredients: 0.5 cup falooda vermicelli, cooked and cooled
2 tbsp basil seeds, soaked until fully swollen and drained
method: Prepare the basil seeds until fully swollen and cook the falooda vermicelli according to its type, then cool both components before assembling.
Divide the rose syrup between two tall serving glasses.
Add the drained basil seeds and cooled vermicelli, distributing them evenly between the glasses.
Pour in the chilled milk slowly so the glass stays cold and the layers remain visible.
Top each glass with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and garnish with chopped nuts.
Serve immediately with a spoon and straw; stir while drinking if you prefer the syrup fully mixed through the milk.
